info.title: Admin Levels API Reference
info.description: Retrieve the administrative level hierarchy for any country using ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country codes. Returns the distinct administrative level types defined for that country (e.g., state, district, province, outlying area) as a flat array of strings. Use the returned level names with the Administrative Units endpoint to filter results by one or more specific levels. A valid two-letter country code is required; invalid codes return a 400 error and countries without published admin levels return a 404.

get.summary: Retrieve administrative level types for a country
get.description: Returns the distinct administrative level types (e.g., province, district, state) defined for a given country using ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code.

parameters.name: format
parameters.description: Format of the response. Possible values: json, xml.

parameters.name: country
parameters.description: Country code in ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 format (e.g., US, PK).

200.description: Successful response with list of administrative levels

400.description: Bad Request — Missing country parameter, or country is not a valid/known ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code

InvalidCountryCode.summary: Malformed or unrecognized country code (also returned for well-formed but non-existent codes)

value.message: Only ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 codes country codes are supported.

404.description: Not Found — Country is a recognized ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code but has no published admin levels (e.g. Vatican City)

NoAdminUnits.summary: No admin units for this country

value.error: No Admin Unit present in country
value.message: This Country does not have any admin units associated with it.

ApiKeyAuthHeader.name: X-apiKey
ApiKeyAuthHeader.description: Pass your API key via the X-apiKey request header.

ApiKeyAuthQuery.name: apiKey
ApiKeyAuthQuery.description: Pass your API key via the apiKey query parameter.

AdminLevelsResponse.description: Response containing the distinct administrative level types defined for the requested country.

admin_levels.description: An array of unique administrative level types defined for the specified country. Each value represents a category of administrative division, such as state, district, or outlying area.

status.description: HTTP status code returned with the error.
